en: A colored illustrated view of a European city along a river, with a metal bridge in the foreground and rows of historic buildings with red and brown roofs along the riverbank. Rising behind the city is a steep, wooded hill topped with fortifications and structures. On the right side of the hill sits a prominent clock tower. At the top right corner of the image is printed the caption "GRAZ. Schloßberg."
